issues: Incorrect calculation of required moves for the last element (`i == n - 1`) when `need > extra_visits_from_left`. The original code subtracted `need - extra_visits_from_left`, but each extra visit to the last element requires bouncing back to the previous element and returning. This costs 2 moves per extra visit (minus 1 for the initial entry). The correct formula is `2 * add - 1`.

The separate `if i == n - 1:` case introduces this flaw. The `2 * add - 1` cost structure mathematically applies to all elements (including the last). We can unify the logic by only skipping the forward step (`moves -= 1`) when `need <= extra_visits_from_left` at the final index since there are no more elements to traverse to.
